family: The single total family F_n defined in proof.md: F_n=0 for n<1024. For n>=1024 let k be the least prime with k^5>32*n^3, m=n-k, r=ceil(m/k), and t=ceil(sqrt(r)). The first k input bits encode the coefficients below the leading term of a monic degree-k binary polynomial q. Output 0 if q is reducible. Otherwise form K=F_2[Z]/(q), pad the remaining m input bits with zeros to r*k bits, and interpret the blocks z_i in the polynomial basis, constant coefficient first. Set y_i=z_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1) and output Tr_(K/F_2)(sum over t-element I subset {1,...,r} of product_(i in I) y_i). The field description is part of the actual n-bit input. The fixed evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier are specified in proof.md.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time Boolean family, hence one language in NP with witness bound zero, C_B2(F_n)>=4*(n-k)-9*(d(n)+1)>=4*n-51*n^(4/5) for every integer n>=1024, where d(n)=ceil(k*r/t)+k*t+r*(r+1)+1. Therefore liminf over all integer lengths n of C_B2(F_n)/n >= 4 in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n=|x|. Equivalently, for every real epsilon>0 there exists N_epsilon such that every integer n>=N_epsilon satisfies C_B2(F_n)>=(4-epsilon)*n.
